input.quote: For personal information processed by IBM on your behalf as part of the Services, IBM will act in accordance with your instructions by following such processing and security obligations as are contained in this Agreement.
input.rationale: A full-text search for insurance/coverage terms returns nothing, and the two candidate provisions contain no coverage obligation: § 14.12 (Risk of Loss) only allocates risk between Base Components and Customer Components, and § 5.3 (Security) is a set of disclaimers rather than an insurance covenant. IBM is a hosting vendor that operates the e-business Hosting Environment and, per § 14.18, processes personal information on our behalf, so the rule's walk-away scenario (no insurance for a vendor processing personal data) applies. Inserted the preferred coverage package (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request) as a new clause in the Section 14 miscellaneous block, with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback flagged in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance clause in Section 14 (Miscellaneous) requiring CGL, E&O and cyber coverage with certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance requirement even though IBM hosts our environment and processes personal information on our behalf, so we have added our standard coverage levels (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M) with certificates on request. If these limits are an issue, we can work with E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.

ops.text: IBM shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. IBM shall provide Customer with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage on request.
